axes.concept: An operational register for the people who imagine, calculate and build decorations: who can enter, and which tools they can use.
axes.layout: An asymmetric 232px editorial margin plus a fluid working ledger, separated by 48px; account forms and their footers share the working-column left edge. The margin becomes a compact heading above content below 768px.
axes.navigation: Three text entries in the editorial margin (Cuentas, Roles y permisos, Mi cuenta), with a neutral active baseline; a named account menu in the masthead. Phone navigation becomes one in-flow horizontal row, not a drawer.
axes.typography: Arial/system sans, 34px compact two-line margin heading against a 24px task title; 13px ledger records and 12px metadata. Monospace is reserved for access times, notice versions and links.
axes.density: Six accounts across six table columns on desktop; flat ruled records instead of cards. Phone records retain company, role, state and last access in a labelled hierarchy. Forms use 22px group gaps and 44px inputs.
axes.components: Real shadcn/Base UI buttons and inputs, Animate UI-backed checkboxes, dialogs, alert dialogs and account dropdown; a custom semantic HTML ledger and typographic rail. Grouped permission checkboxes act as a tool-access receipt.
axes.colour: Existing Pictures light lavender-neutral canvas and near-black dark canvas, mapped to kit roles. Purple identifies the primary action and registration rule; green/amber communicate account state. Readable project text tokens also supply control edges.
axes.motion: Precise registration rather than elastic bounce: a left-origin rule sweep, 12px pane cut, 5px title lock and 7px row settling with 35ms successive delays, cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1). Profile-scaled entrance ~340ms expressive / 178ms natural / 113ms subtle; repeat hover/press stays 150–160ms. Reduced motion and still=1 show the same final content immediately.
